variants.candidate: Wood is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is the work that leaves something usable behind. Practice gives a skill more range. Repairs keep a tool in service, and care gives a plan time to grow beyond its first good idea. Your effort has somewhere to stay.
variants.original: Wood is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is effort that behaves like a living thing. Whatever you plant and keep tending, money, skills, ventures, trust, grows on its own schedule and pays you back with interest, because your work compounds instead of burning off.

variants.candidate: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is the part of your effort that reaches another person. A thought becomes a sentence someone can follow, or care becomes a meal you share. What you make gives your attention somewhere beyond yourself to go.
variants.original: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is output that flows. Words, cooking, small kindnesses, the bright remark that turns an evening: whatever is inside you moves outward without forcing, and people are fed by it before they notice they were hungry.

variants.candidate: Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is a demand that gives your strength a direction. Deadlines make the next choice concrete. Rules give effort a limit, and a difficult task can gather your attention around what actually needs doing.
variants.original: Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is structure with heat in it. Pressure organizes you instead of scattering you, rules turn into momentum, and when things fall apart you are the one holding a straight line through the middle of it.
